320	Forty.	Quarenta.
321	Forty.	Quarenta.
322	What happened?	O que aconteceu?
323	Was he stuck in shidduchim?	Ele ficou encalhado nos shidduchim?
324	Why didn't he marry earlier?	Por que não se casou antes?
325	At eighteen, to the chuppah.	Aos 18 anos, para a chupá.
326	What was he doing for forty years?	O que ele fez durante 40 anos?
327	How did he not find a match?	Como não achou um shidduch?
328	Until age forty he found no match?	Até os 40 anos não achou um shidduch?
329	Today they would call him stuck in shidduchim, an old bachelor.	Hoje o chamariam de encalhado nos shidduchim, um solteirão.
330	What would they be saying?	O que estariam dizendo?
331	No, that was the question.	Não, essa era a pergunta.
332	But with Yitzchak it's not the same, because Yitzchak Avinu, his match had not yet been born.	Mas com Yitzchak não é igual, porque Yitzchak Avinu ainda não tinha nascido o seu shidduch.
333	Only at the Akeidah his match was born, he was told Rivkah was born, and he took her at age three.	Só na Akedá nasceu o seu shidduch, anunciaram-lhe que Rivká nasceu, e ele a tomou aos três anos.
334	But today, today that is a relatively late age.	Mas hoje, hoje essa é uma idade relativamente tardia.
335	I didn't understand at all.	Eu não entendi nada.
336	So now, the Kli Yakar writes: why did Avraham Avinu go to Padan Aram to bring	Então agora, o Kli Yakar escreve: por que Avraham Avinu foi a Padan Aram buscar
337	a wife from there?	uma esposa de lá?
338	There are plenty of fish in the sea.	Há muito peixe no mar.
339	Here in the land of Canaan, were there no women?	Aqui na terra de Canaã faltavam mulheres?
340	There were women.	Havia mulheres.
341	So why did he go there?	Então por que ele foi para lá?
342	He writes: good midot in Padan Aram. So writes the Kli Yakar, and I wonder.	Ele escreve: boas midot em Padan Aram. Assim escreve o Kli Yakar, e eu me espanto.
343	A great wonder.	Um enorme espanto.
344	Good midot?	Boas midot?
345	Yes.	Sim.
346	Good midot in Padan Aram?	Boas midot em Padan Aram?
347	They tried to murder him, to kill him, they switched his cups, wanted to rob him, wanted to delay	Tentaram assassiná-lo, matá-lo, trocaram-lhe os copos, quiseram roubá-lo, quiseram atrasar
348	everything. "Let the girl stay with us a year or ten months," after they had said yes,	tudo. "Que a moça fique conosco um ano ou dez meses", depois de terem dito sim,
349	"Take Rivkah and go." To delay the match, to murder him. He tried to murder him, and in the end Betuel died,	"Leve Rivká e vá." Atrasar o shidduch, assassiná-lo. Tentou assassiná-lo, e no fim Betuel morreu,
350	Rivkah's father. Lavan tried to rob him. "When he saw the bracelets	o pai de Rivká. Lavan tentou roubá-lo. "Quando viu os braceletes"
351	that the servant had put on her arm," he immediately ran outside. What made him run?	que o servo pôs no braço dela, correu logo para fora. O que o fez correr?
352	What was the motive?	Qual era o motivo?
353	Money, that was the motive. And more, why "Lavan"?	Dinheiro, esse era o motivo. E mais, por que "Lavan"?
354	Lavan "haArami": Chazal expound "haArami" as "haRamai," the deceiver. He was a deceiver, and it was not	Lavan "haArami": Chazal expõem "haArami" como "haRamai", o enganador. Ele era um enganador, e não foi
355	for nothing that they called him Lavan. He was known for it, he was an exploiter,	à toa que o chamaram Lavan. Era conhecido por isso, era um aproveitador,
356	he was one of the exploiters. So you come and tell me good midot?	era dos aproveitadores. E você vem me dizer boas midot?
357	What good midot?	Que boas midot?
358	These are good midot?	Isso são boas midot?
359	They tried to murder him, to ruin, to cheat, to steal, to rob, to destroy, to… these are	Tentaram assassiná-lo, arruinar, enganar, roubar, assaltar, destruir… essas são
